notes.title: Another World - 20th Anniversary Edition - Game Update
notes.content:
Dear community, dear fans,

Last month, we have updated the PC VERSION of Another World - 20th Anniversary for the first time on Steam.

Eric Chahi and our friends at Goblinz have developed this update to make this version similar to the console versions.

- All backgrounds of the game are now in 1080p 
- Fixing gameplay scripting  
- Fixing minor bug
- Adding 8 new languages :  Simplified Chinese - Brazilian Portuguese - Japanese - Korean - Portuguese - Polish - Russian and Turkish 

Thank you again for your support, and do not hesitate to reach our technical support to report any issue: support@thedigitalounge.com

Stay safe,

Digital Lounge Team

notes.title: A live event for the 30th anniversary of Another World on December 11, 2021!
notes.content:
The association [b]MO5.COM[/b] and [b]The Digital Lounge[/b] are honored to invite you to an exceptional live event [b]on Saturday, December 11th at 6pm CET[/b] on the [b]Twitch channel of MO5[/b] in order to celebrate together the 30th anniversary of Another World (1991). To talk about this classic game that never ceases to inspire gamers and creators, we will of course be accompanied by its author, Eric Chahi, who was awarded the National Order of Merit in early May, and its composer and high school friend Jean-François Freitas.

The live event will be hosted by our friend and journalist Patrick Hellio with the complicity of the association's president and vice-president, Philippe Dubois and David Soumet, and the founder of Digital Lounge, Abrial Da Costa, who takes care to preserve and perpetuate the memory of this great game. Many guests are also invited to this celebration, such as Romain Tisserand, co-founder of Dotemu at the origin of the re-release of the classic on mobiles, Paul Cuisset, who notably worked with Eric on Future Wars (1989), and Jacques Harbonn, journalist and reviewer of the very first version of Another World in French Tilt Magazine.

Come and ask your questions live and some surprises will be waiting for you too...

[b]

notes.title: Developers and industry legends on the games that defined the last 20 years
notes.content:
As Eurogamer turns 20, we thought, you know what? It's not all about us. It's also about the developers, the people behind the virtual magic that inspired the creation of Eurogamer two decades ago. Without the developers, we wouldn't be here. And so, we thought we'd ask a few of them (20, in fact!) to pick the games that defined the last 20 years, and see what would come of it.

We approached a broad range of people, from top executives and legendary talent to tiny indies. We asked them to pick a game that defined the last 20 years, but left it up to them to interpret the question. It could be a game that defined the industry, that meant a lot to them professionally or personally, or is just a favourite.

We're delighted with the responses (thank you to everyone who contributed!). There's some fantastic insight here, super cool anecdotes and the odd surprising choice. We hope you enjoy it!

Find out about Eric Chahi, creator of Another World (aka, Out of This World) and From Dust, with this unique biography retracing his career as an artist and game designer. Written by Daniel Ichbiah, writer and journalist specializing in video games, Eric Chahi – Journey of a French Video Game Creator, takes you on a path full of magic and waking reveries, to the heart of the artist’s work, his inspirations, his world; the story of a man who dreamed about Another World…

Take the chance to rediscover the epic game Another World, one of Eric Chahi’s masterpieces remastered in HD within this dedicated boxset! Read the story of one of the greatest game designers of the 1990s through this unique work. Eric Chahi takes the reader backstage, from the dawn of microcomputing to French video game development in the 1980s and 1990s and the democratization of gaming. A fascinating glimpse of the birth of an industry, full of key moments, disappointments, rebounds and last-minute victories!

notes.title: Another World out now on Xbox One, PlayStation version mysteriously delayed
notes.content: The 20th anniversary edition of Another World was originally supposed to arrive today on Sony platforms. However, it appears that the game has been stealth delayed to a future date. Meanwhile, the Xbox One version of the PC classic was suddenly been released earlier today.

notes.title: Another World coming to PS4 next week
notes.content: We heard rumblings of Another World coming to consoles a few months back, and now it's preparing to roll out. It's due on PlayStation 4 next week, June 25, and we presume the other consoles mentioned in the leak (PlayStation 3, Xbox One, Wii U, 3DS, and Vita) won't be far behind.

notes.title: Another World 20th Anniversary rated for consoles
notes.content: The 1991 sci-fi adventure game Another World received a 20th Anniversary update a few years ago. That version appears to be expanding to many more platforms, as the German ratings board outed it for PlayStation 3, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Wii U, 3DS, and Vita.

notes.title: Public Beta for the control issue
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Some people are experiencing a control issue with the game and we've launched an investigation about it.

We think we found a good fix but before to release the fix to everyone, we'd like to involve people into a public beta in order to confirm that the fix works and doesn't create side effects.

The fix is only available for the PC version and to get it, please follow the below Step:

1 - Go to your Steam Library.
2 - Right-click on Another World and select "Properties".
3 - Go to the "Betas" tab. If you don't have the tab, restart Steam.
4 - Select in the list "beta" to opt in and quit the "Properties" panel. Steam will update automatically the game with the fix.

The public beta will be last until Monday 16th to be sure that everyone get the chance to test it.

And please, leave a comment [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/233550/discussions/0/864978835518080213/]there[/url] to let us know if it works or not.

Best,
Thierry

notes.title: Gaming Made Me: Another World
notes.content:
Another World’s 20th Anniversary Edition is now available on Steam. In 1992, when I first played it, discovering something so beautiful and strange contained on two disks seemed like an act of science fiction in itself, and realising that I can now download the entire thing in about four seconds is astonishing. Eric Chahi’s enduring voyage is a masterwork of visual communication and companionship, and it has grown in my memory over the two decades since its original release.

notes.title: Now Available - Another World
notes.content:
Another World is Now Available on Steam!

Also known as Out Of This World™, Another World is a pioneer action/platformer that released across more than a dozen platforms since its debut in 1991. Along the years, Another World™ has attained cult status among critics and sophisticated gamers alike.

Another World™ chronicles the story of Lester Knight Chaykin a young scientist hurtled through space and time by a nuclear experiment that goes wrong. In an alien and inhospitable world, you will have to dodge, outwit, and overcome the host of alien monsters, while surviving an environment as deadly as your enemies. Only a perfect blend of logic and skill will get you past the deadly obstacles that lie in wait.
